content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for AIIMS Jammu Senior Resident / Senior Demonstrator posts is 27-08-2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident / Senior Demonstrator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 40 vacancies for the Senior Resident / Senior Demonstrator positions announced by AIIMS Jammu in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an MD/DNB/MS/DM/MCh/MDS in the relevant specialty. For non-medical posts, an M.Sc. with Ph.D. is required in select departments.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Jammu recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 1500. SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 1000, and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 56100 to Rs. 67700 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Interview. Candidates who perform well in the interview will be shortlisted.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the job type for the Senior Resident / Senior Demonstrator posts at AIIMS Jammu is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed via the 'Official Notification PDF' link in the Important Links section of this article. It contains all detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of AIIMS Jammu?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jammu is located in Awantipora, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 192122.
